title: PAR-20/7G.3 Background key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit the generated six-kind ACAD_BACKGROUND round-trip for duplicate root or child dictionary targets.
Require one NOD key, one dictionary entry per retained Background handle, and unique nonempty OBJECTS handles.
Reuse the existing generated ASCII/Binary selector without adding CTest inventory or persistent fixtures.

sourceChange.change: The Background round-trip now counts the ACAD_BACKGROUND root key, requires exactly one dictionary entry targeting each re-imported Background handle, and rejects duplicate or missing OBJECTS handles in the emitted-record scan.
sourceChange.reason: Previous presence checks could permit duplicate dictionary keys to point at one Background while another child was not uniquely reachable; the order scan also did not verify section-wide handle uniqueness.
